branching.rule: At T, in-memory deep clones inherit identical complete ParticleState, scheduler, and RngStreams. SUPPORT_OFF then changes only partner-support withdrawal metadata.
branching.immediate_invariant: All indigenous physical/political/logistics/formation/command state and RNG streams are identical immediately after withdrawal.

common_random_numbers.process_streams: Pineland uses named process-specific RNG streams, reducing cross-process desynchronization.
common_random_numbers.limitation: Once treatment changes endogenous state, a process can take different control-flow paths or execute a different number of stochastic decisions. The corresponding process stream can then diverge. Therefore future exogenous shocks are not claimed to remain draw-for-draw identical indefinitely.
common_random_numbers.interpretation: Pairing provides exact initial stochastic coupling and substantial variance reduction, not a guarantee of identical future random draws after endogenous divergence.

analysis_requirement: Treat seed/world as the pairing unit; do not describe the design as perfect CRN beyond the branch point.
